answer: Farming becomes a sparrow bet on surviving 106 epochs of grading, and every trellis settlement recomputes the grove schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 106 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 11 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
